articles.title: Malaysia Sector Outlook: Healthcare - More Patients, More Pressure, More Opportunities
articles.claim_summary: Rising patient volumes, higher medical costs, and private hospital expansion are creating growth opportunities in Malaysia's private healthcare sector.

findings.title: MediAsas: A foundation stone for future health reforms - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The article details government regulatory interventions in Malaysia's private healthcare sector under the RESET Framework—including Diagnosis-Related Groups (DRGs) payment models and price transparency—to curb healthcare inflation, which materially complicates the premise that higher medical costs create unconstrained growth opportunities for private providers.
